shared_elements: relief carving on an upright slab/pillar
incised outlines on a flat vertical field
justification: Both are upright slabs bearing low-relief incised imagery with animal-derived or face-like forms, but A is a dense grid of framed, ornate glyph-like cartouches in ordered rows and columns, while B shows a single large quadruped in profile with a subsidiary elongated creature below, freely placed on an open field. The organisational logic (repeated bordered sign-blocks vs. isolated naturalistic animal in profile) and the level of abstraction are quite different, so only generic relief-carving traits are shared.
